svg.title: Where the agents went
svg.desc: Three maps of the route from Pallet Town (bottom) to Route 2 (top), one per agent, at the 5M checkpoint: trained on the score (batch 2), trained on the capped score (round 1), and random play. Each square is shaded by the share of test episodes that stepped on it. Below each map: the share of episodes that entered each building and the forest.
svg.text: start: Oak's Lab (Pallet Town, bottom); 5M checkpoint, one sample: scores swing between checkpoints
